note: A third set of invented messages, written after the rules were widened and never used to tune them: the honest score as of 15 Nov 2026. Same format as messages.json.

messages.text: Beavers update: our sleepover at the scout hut is on the weekend of 5th-6th December. Drop off 5pm Saturday. Kids will need a sleeping bag, torch and pyjamas. Please pay the £15 via OSM by 28th Nov.
Good afternoon Year 2! A reminder that our class assembly is this Friday at 2.45pm and you are all welcome to come and watch.
Brownies meets every Tuesday in the church hall from 6 till 7.30pm. No meeting on 22nd December.
Year 7 parents' information evening will be held on Tuesday 24 November from 6pm. Please confirm attendance by replying to this email.

[16/11/2026, 21:02] Hannah: Can someone remind me when the PTA bake off is?
[16/11/2026, 21:04] Kate: it's next Thursday after school!

Dear Parents and Carers
On Monday 7th December Year 4 will be visiting the National Museum as part of their Romans topic. The cost of the trip is £8.50, which should be paid on ParentPay no later than Monday 30th November. Children will need a packed lunch in a disposable bag.
Yours sincerely
Mr Hughes
Hi, this is Smile Dental. Your son's appointment has been moved to Monday 23rd November at 4pm. Reply YES to confirm.
After school clubs finish for the term on 11th December and restart the week beginning 11th January.
Christmas lunch is on Wednesday 16th December. If your child usually has a packed lunch and would like Christmas lunch, please order it on the app by 2nd December.
Hey! Would Zara like to come over to ours on Saturday afternoon to play? Mia's been asking all week
Please note the flu vaccinations planned for tomorrow have been postponed. A new date will be confirmed soon.
Can we remind everyone that hoodies are not part of the school uniform. Thank you for your support.

Dates for your diary:
Nativity - 9th December
Carol concert - 15th December, 6pm at St John's
Last day of term - 18th December (finishes 1.30pm)
From next week, swimming will be on Wednesday mornings for Year 3, so please send kits in on Wednesdays.
Reminder - school disco tickets go on sale tonight at 7pm on the PTA website, £4 each.
